profile.brim_policy: Inherit the saved setting. Read and report actual emitted brim paths, including none when the slicer omits a brim.

assembly_tool.purpose: Load each spring in turn; remove before operation.

checks: Both-end spring capture at every stop and with unequal hand motion
Spring tension, operating feel and whole-span rigidity
Valve tie installation, four-tube insertion/release and relocking
Pump mounting, connectors, flexible feet, screw/washer seating and hose retention
Shell closure, accepted covers/nameplate and actual made-up gas-fitting fit

operating_policy.instruction: Continue productive printing while checks proceed, or cancel a concretely defective job and switch to useful work. Send only the exact reviewed archive after its machine is available and plate is cleared.
operating_policy.filament_instruction: Start ready jobs with the correct material mapping regardless of remaining spool quantity. Use the spool until runout and reload as needed. Ask for filament only when an actual reload requires the user.

geometry_qualification.scope: Updated assembly and the corrected G Ganen cap/lid; unchanged shell/carrier/tool geometry retains its original exact native/support reviews. Back-top has only a native-equal 0.000016 mm maximum mesh variation.

execution_status_scope: print_released and submitted record printer execution. Full-enclosure printing is already user-authorized; an offline-ready job needs no additional design or permission approval.
print_released_scope: At least one of the seven production plates has started; per-job execution flags remain authoritative.

continuity.schedule: Every 2 hours in the coordinating task
continuity.behavior: Advance exact reviewed jobs when their machine is free and its latest print is removed. Use each spool fully and reload on actual runout; never ask about or gate on remaining quantity. Stay quiet during normal printing; do not pause for design review or add coupons; stop after the full set is finished.
continuity.authority: Coordinating task created the heartbeat automation.

printer_schedule.after: Back-top is running; front-top and pusher are finished and removed.
Carrier pair is running. The display cover is next, then front-top v7, whose open-backed catches take it. Back-bottom goes to whichever printer frees first.

queue_estimates.scope: All seven production plates at their full original slice estimates, including submitted plates. Excludes the cartridge/cap, countertop, plate changes, cleanup and assembly. These are not remaining-time commitments.

independent_job_release: A completed job may advance through normal printer handoff while other queued jobs are still under review.
